company_profile: ABN AMRO is a Dutch bank whose Enterprise Enabling Data Domain builds AI and business insight products for teams across the bank.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years designing machine learning and LLM solutions and bringing them into production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds generative and agentic AI, including LangGraph multi-agent and RAG systems, alongside classical ML on Databricks, Spark and Azure with MLflow-based MLOps and monitoring. Translates business questions into AI opportunities and advises stakeholders on evaluation and model quality. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Enterprise Metadata Knowledge Assistant
bullets: Built an agentic RAG assistant in LangGraph that answered questions over enterprise data catalogues and metadata, combining vector retrieval with a knowledge graph of dataset lineage and ownership.
Evaluated answers with LLM evaluators on a labelled question set, tracked runs in MLflow on Databricks, and served the assistant through FastAPI with tracing to support model governance reviews.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in the Enterprise Enabling Data Domain at ABN AMRO. Over more than eight years I have moved from classical machine learning in telecom to LLM and agentic systems in healthcare, and the constant has been the same: take a business question and bring a working AI product into production.

A bank that wants its data scientists to be the experts other departments turn to, and that takes responsible AI seriously, is where I want to do this work, because the people a model affects rarely see it. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to the Netherlands together and settle there long term.

In my current data science work at United Health Group I built a LangGraph multi-agent analytics chatbot that answers business questions with PySpark analysis and cut manual analysis by 98%, with evaluation pipelines that reduced human review by 43%. Earlier, at Viavi, I shipped a LightGBM SLA breach model with MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real users, carefully, and explaining what a model can and cannot do. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
